title: "Write a single library to handle all input devices, it'll be easy" they said...
summary: Peter Hutterer's linux.conf.au 2020 talk on creating libinput, the unified userspace input library, and the difficulties of handling the many quirks of input devices.
why: Cited for insight into the hard realities of Linux input handling and libinput's thinly staffed maintenance.

quote.text: One of the folks behind both Wayland and X gave a fantastic talk on the issues and the hell.
